title: NASA Will Spend $843 Million To Bring The ISS Down
hook: NASA will spend $843 million to deliberately end the ISS.
closing: Ending our space home safely costs almost as much as building a new mission.
question: What should replace the ISS?

segments.say: The ISS supported 24 years of continuous human presence from 2000 to 2024.
NASA spends $3 billion yearly on the ISS after $150 billion total.
The ISS deorbit contract costs $843 million versus $450 million for a shuttle launch.
